note: Launch/config manifest for two role-filtered MCP servers plus one fixed desktop text-pilot server. The broad-server tool_filter arrays are the UNION across roles only for host discovery; each broad server requires HERMES_AGENT_ROLE and registers only that canonical roles.json allowlist. The desktop server is outside roles.json and exposes exactly three tenant/user/current-role/device-bound read/draft tools. The Frappe server also requires HERMES_ACTOR_USER, and its Frappe API pair must belong to exactly that actor rather than a shared service principal; it assignment-scopes Field Companion calls. Frappe approved writes require ERPNEXT_WRITE_ENABLED plus a short-lived server-issued dry_run_receipt and separately signed human approval_receipt; HERMES_DRY_RUN_SIGNING_KEY stays in the MCP host, HERMES_APPROVAL_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE verifies the approval broker's signature, and HERMES_APPROVER_ID binds that key to the approved human identity. The bus retains its separate IRONWRAP_BUS_WRITE_ENABLED + HERMES_WRITE_TOKEN replay gate. Newo MCP never receives the provider API key; NEWO_MCP_WRITE_ENABLED gates its approval tools while the Worker independently enforces signed one-time receipts, NEWO_CONTROL_WRITE_ENABLED, protected resources, and NEWO_OUTBOUND_ENABLED. env values are placeholders resolved from the Hermes host environment; never commit real secret values.

ironwrap-bus-mcp.description: Bus readiness and operating truth plus approved, envelope-scoped dead-letter recovery.

ironwrap-hermes-desktop-mcp.description: Fixed owner/ops desktop text pilot: device-bound task reads, untrusted context staging, and governed draft handoff only.

newo-mcp.description: Role-filtered Newo session, conversation, configuration, analytics, and exact-receipt control through bounded Worker routes.
